_comment: Empirical Gaussian timing model for adjacent keypresses. Values are (mean, std) inter-key intervals in milliseconds, sourced from published keystroke-dynamics studies (Monrose & Rubin 1997; Song, Miller, & Stahie 2001; Killourhy & Maxion 2009 — averaged across touch typists). Used as priors by the OpenSSH subtab decoder; heuristic digraph table takes precedence when an entry is present. The bundled ``layout`` is QWERTY; users can override it (DVORAK, Colemak, AZERTY, custom splits, etc.) by editing the ``layout`` field — the decoder geometry is data-driven. [v2 schema: weight envelopes added on baselines and empirical entries per scripts/WEIGHT_SCHEMA.md; metadata.schemaVersion = 2.]

metadata.notes: Weight envelopes added on baselines (5 categories) and empirical entries (124 digraphs). Reader compatibility: weight is a sibling key of mean/std, so v1 readers that only access entry.mean / entry.std keep working unchanged. See scripts/WEIGHT_SCHEMA.md for the field definitions and scripts/merge_empirical.py for the auto-migrator.
